ValidationRule.description: 當Transportation = Use Hertz rental car (arranged by passenger) (Hertz租車)，【Canlead / Hertz Order No.】為必填
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL(Transportation__c, "Use Hertz rental car (arranged by passenger)"), ISBLANK(Canlead_Hertz_Order_No__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When the Transportation = Use Hertz rental car (arranged by passenger), the【Canlead / Hertz Order No.】can't be empty.
